overall: One continuous read of the whole passage in one take, as a person from Texas who knows this subject and is explaining plainly what a university published. Plainspoken and human. Not a news anchor, not a documentary hush, not an explainer's bright lift. Begin at once with no build-up. The energy moves in drops as well as lifts: a lift in the second line, a clear lift in the fourth, steady through the fifth, level in the sixth, and lowest and most certain on the last three lines. Carry every sentence join with no reset of pitch or pace. Say UT as two letters, U and T. Say AI as two letters, A and I, both times it appears. Say San Antonio the Texas way, with the stress on the TOH in Antonio, not the Spanish stress. Read ninety eight point eight two percent as one number, with eight and two spoken together. Say its as an unstressed possessive, never it's. Say still with a short i, as in hill. Read every word of the spoken text exactly as written, with nothing added, dropped, reordered or reworded. Give a breath, never a hold, only at the clause joins named in each line and at the full stops. Do not put any silence between sentences, because the film is cut to this recording. Keep one steady, brisk conversational pace from the first word to the last, about the speed of a person reading aloud to a colleague, and do not slow down for the last lines. Let the final phrase settle with no upturn at the end.
performance_arc: Plain and close at the start, quicker through lines two and three, a lift on line four, steady through line five, then slower and level on the figure and the close.

lines.text: UT San Antonio says some people could have ankle-deep water in their yard before a flood warning sounds on their phone.
lines.intent: Working level from the first word, plain and close, delivered as what a source says. Keep could have as a possibility. Stress lands on the phrase named as emphasis.
lines.energy: Opening line. Start at working level with no hush and no build. Keep it below the lift that follows, and let the pitch settle toward the end of the sentence.
lines.pause_after: A breath at the join after yard, where the clause ends and before begins, with no hold. The rest of the sentence runs on. Full stop at phone, a normal breath, and the next line joins with no reset.
lines.reason: Orient. The water tops the curb and climbs the post at s1-event-1, the boots and the dark phone show at s1-event-2, and the late banner at s1-event-3 is the picture of before a flood warning sounds. The stress lands on the late banner.

lines.text: So its researchers built a flood station that charges itself from light and needs no cell tower.
lines.intent: Plain and forward, the first clear lift, not triumphant. The word So opens low and joins the previous sentence with no reset.
lines.energy: The first clear lift. Opens low, rises through the middle and holds to the final word without a drop.
lines.pause_after: No break inside the sentence, so the phrase runs from So through light and into needs no cell tower. Full stop at tower, a normal breath, and the next line carries straight on.
lines.reason: Reveal. The station is shown at s2-event-1. The stress lands on the panel and the battery bar at s2-event-2, which is the charge the phrase names. The needs no cell tower clause is carried by the dashed line that stops short at s2-event-3. See flag G9.

lines.text: Four optical sensors at different heights watch the water, along with rain, temperature, humidity and light.
lines.intent: An even working explanation, one steady run through the list. Say every word of at different heights whole and unslurred, as three plain separate words, with the stress on different and none on the list items.
lines.energy: A step down from the lift, quicker and even in tempo. No extra lift on the list.
lines.pause_after: A breath at the comma after water, the clause join, with no hold. The list of readings runs on with no breath inside it. Full stop at light, a normal breath, and the next line joins with no reset.
lines.reason: Explain. The four lenses at four heights are on screen at s3-event-1, which is where the stress falls. The brown water crossing the marks at s3-event-2 and the weather lamps at s3-event-3 carry the rest of the sentence.

lines.text: A small chip on the station runs the AI itself, so it judges flood risk without a central server.
lines.intent: The turn of the film, firm and forward. Keep the pitch up through the first clause, and let the stress phrase land at the same level.
lines.energy: The clear lift of the middle, the discovery point. Firm and forward, pitch held up through the sentence.
lines.pause_after: A breath at the comma after itself, the clause join, with no hold. The so it judges flood risk phrase runs on into without a central server. Full stop at server, a normal breath, and the next line joins with no reset.
lines.reason: Reveal. The readings reach the chip at s4-event-1 and the amber risk lamp lights at s4-event-2, so the local judgment is seen before it is named. The server outline stays dark with no line at s4-event-3, which is the picture the stressed phrase answers. See flag G3.

lines.text: When the risk rises, a radio signal can carry more than a half-mile through city streets, and up to five miles in open country, to a hub.
lines.intent: Even and steady through both ranges, each qualifier kept. The upper bound is the only stress. The sentence ends where the destination ends.
lines.energy: Steady and even, a step below the turn, neither rising nor falling. Both ranges sit at one level.
lines.pause_after: A breath at the comma after rises, and a breath at the comma after streets, both clause joins, with no hold. A breath at the comma after country, before to a hub. Full stop at hub, a normal breath, and the next line joins with no reset.
lines.reason: Explain. The rings leave the antenna at s5-event-1 and pass the more than a half mile tag at s5-event-2, said at the same level and without stress so it does not read as the bigger claim. The stress on up to five miles lands on the five-mile tag and the hub mast at s5-event-3. This is the longest sentence in the passage and the most likely line to run long. See flag K2.

lines.text: At the hub, a second, larger AI model draws a map of how flooding could spread, for emergency responders.
lines.intent: Level and plain. Could stays a possibility on the stress phrase. No lift on the model and no lift at the end.
lines.energy: Level and plain, a step below the previous line.
lines.pause_after: A breath at the comma after hub, which follows a noun. A breath at the comma after spread, the clause join, with no hold, and no breath after for. Full stop at responders, a normal breath, and the next line joins with no reset.
lines.reason: Explain. The hub dashboard and the station dots arrive at s6-event-1, the shaded paths spread at s6-event-2, where the stress on could spread lands, and the risk zones and responder tag come at s6-event-3. The picture at s6-event-1 shows several stations feeding the hub, which conflicts with the later no installation line. See flag P2.

lines.text: The university reports ninety eight point eight two percent validation accuracy from early assessments after training, and no field result.
lines.intent: A measured figure said flat with every qualifier in one run, then the limit, the quietest and most certain part of the passage.
lines.energy: The figure runs at one even level. The final phrase drops to the lowest energy in the passage, with the least pitch movement in the read. Stay low through the last word.
lines.pause_after: No break in the figure, from the number through validation accuracy and from early assessments after training. A breath at the comma after training, the clause join, with no hold. And no field result runs straight to the full stop, then a normal breath into the closing line.
lines.reason: Qualify. The figure fills at s7-event-1 and the after training tag pins under it at s7-event-2, so the qualifiers are spoken with the figure they qualify. The stress on no field result lands on the blank card and the none reported stamp at s7-event-3, the picture of the missing record. See flag G6.

lines.text: It names no town that has installed one.
lines.intent: Level and plain, a second short limit that follows the previous one at the same low, certain level.
lines.energy: Level with the end of the previous line, low and plain, no lift. Stay low through the last word.
lines.pause_after: No breath inside the sentence. Full stop at one, a normal breath, and the close starts as its own line.
lines.reason: The search ring at s8-event-2 finds no installed station, and this sentence says so. See flag G7.

lines.intent: The close as its own short phrase. Say still with a short i as in hill, whole and unhurried. The stress word carries the open state and is the last thing heard.
lines.energy: Settles to the same low, certain level and falls to the end, with no upturn.
lines.pause_after: No breath inside the close, either between is and still or after still. Full stop at goal, and the take ends with no tail.
lines.reason: The close lands on still while the goal pin hovers and does not land at s9-event-1, so the picture and the closing phrase answer the same open question without implying approval. See flag G8.
